newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan FGEP group buys 54,000T US corn at tender.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan FGEP group buys 54,000T US corn at tender.

text.p: Taiwan's FGEP corn-buying group bought a 54,000-tonne shipment of U.S. No.2 corn from U.S. giant Cargill at a tender on Thursday, local traders said.
Traders said the tender was unusual in that it specifies relatively distant May-to-June shipment delivery.
Traders attributed the long lead time to FGEP's apparent concern over a possible rally in the corn futures market.
"The FGEP group is worried that corn may be heading for a rally," a trader said.
An FGEP buyer said the entire shipment was bought on a flat price of US$151.50 per tonne to lock in current prices.
Traders said there was no indication that other Taiwan corn buying groups would follow FGEP's lead and enter the market.
The shipment was bought on a cost-and-freight basis, traders said.
The FGEP group comprises Fwu Sow Grain, Great Wall Enterprise, President Enterprise, Ever Smile Feed Mill Co and group newcomer Fong Yu.
